text: Dark clouds gather on a cloudless day. Lightning coils within them, drawn to the power you have gathered.

outcomes.text: Nine bolts fall and you stand through all of them. The sky clears, and your body feels reforged.
The lightning breaks you. You wake charred and humbled.
The formation absorbs most of the lightning, and a little of its power seeps into you.

text: Beside a roaring waterfall, a thought you have chased for years suddenly clicks into place.

choices.label: Sit and let the insight unfold

outcomes.text: The insight blooms into a flash of understanding about the Dao.
The insight slips away like water. Still, the calm remains.
Your notes will help you, and others, for years.

text: A landslide uncovers the entrance to an ancient ruin, its stone gate carved with faded formations.

choices.label: Break through the gate and explore

outcomes.text: Deep inside, an armory untouched for ten thousand years yields a shimmering blade.
A sealed chamber holds a ring humming with calm.
You loot the outer halls and find coins and qi stones.
The ruin's guardians are still awake.
Some doors are best left shut.

text: A merchant in star-patterned robes sets up a stall that was not there yesterday, and none of the passersby seem to see it.

outcomes.text: The pearl glows warmly in your palm. The merchant smiles and fades from view.

choices.label: Buy a Heavenly Dao Pill (200 gold)

outcomes.text: A single pill, wrapped in a leaf of starlight.
The merchant laughs and tosses you a pill. 'For your nerve.'
The stall is empty when you look up.

text: A figure in white descends from the clouds and offers you a post in the Heavenly Court, with honors and eternal service.

choices.label: Accept the post for a time

outcomes.text: You serve the court for a few years and return, richer in wisdom, lifespan and enemies.

choices.label: Decline and stay in the mortal world

outcomes.text: The envoy shrugs. 'The world will remember you, then.'

text: A beast tide pours out of the wilds, and a border town begs for protection.

outcomes.text: You hold the walls until the tide breaks. The townsfolk shower you with thanks.
The walls hold, but barely. You bleed for it.
You do not look back. The smoke on the horizon lingers in your mind.

text: A cultivator thought long dead strides out of a sealed cave, saying that your name woke him from an old grudge.

outcomes.text: A duel that shakes the mountain ends in your favor. His stash is yours.
He is stronger than he looks. You flee with injuries and a promise of a rematch.
A long evening of tea and talk, and the grudge dissolves into respect.
He sneers and leaves. The grudge remains.

text: While digging a cellar, a villager strikes a vein of raw spirit stone and runs to ask for your advice.

outcomes.text: Weeks of work yield a hoard of spirit stones, and the air around the vein hums with qi.
The village prospers, and you earn a modest finder's share and warm gratitude.

text: Your senses brush against a thin place in the world where space folds. Beyond it you sense an endless dark.

outcomes.text: In silence and darkness, your qi dilates. You return with the memory of the stars.
The void tugs at your soul, and you claw your way back, shaken.
A small act of care that few would ever notice.

text: A forgotten forge deep in the mountains still burns. On its anvil, a blade waits for a master worthy of it.

outcomes.text: The blade accepts you. It hums with a power that makes the air quiver.
The blade rejects you with a blast of killing intent.
You spend a year at the forge and learn the secrets of forging with spirit fire.

text: A hidden garden unfolds beneath your feet, where flowers bloom in colors that have no names.

choices.label: Eat the fruit of the central tree

outcomes.text: The fruit dissolves into radiance. Years fall away from you.
The garden's guardian spirit objects, with great force.

choices.label: Take only a single seed and leave

outcomes.text: You plant the seed in your courtyard and a small phoenix feather blooms from it.

text: A storm of tribulation lightning rolls across the sky for no clear reason, tempting you to harvest its power.

choices.label: Draw the lightning into your meridians

outcomes.text: The lightning tempers your body. You step out of the storm glowing.
The lightning is wilder than it looked. You are thrown across the valley.
A good lesson in the Dao of restraint.
